text:
Maya Chen: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

What I did: polished content calendar for the launch week, wrote the benchmark post draft, updated example prompts in the blog draft.
Blockers: waiting on engineering bench numbers for the new embed endpoint (latency + token cost), and final hero image from design.
Today: finalize blog, push benchmark dataset to S3, coordinate promo copy with Kevin.

Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/launchsprint/content/benchmarks (please comment) @Alex Rivera — can you eyeball the embed perf numbers when you have a moment? Also need a quick CR on the bench script (PR #482). :wave:

Alex Rivera: I can take a look after 14:00 PT. I skimmed PR #482 — small nit on the logging but should be quick.
Quick note on env: run the bench with the `--stable` profile to match prod routing. Example: `./bench/run.sh --suite=content-embed --profile=stable`

Kevin Patel: Nice — what's the target uplift we're trying to show in the post? baseline P95 / cost per 1k tokens? Want to align the callouts.
Also planning a short tweet thread and a benchmark screenshot for the carousel. Need the raw numbers by EOD so design can make the graphic.

Sophie Li: for the hero — final asset needs to be 1200x630, provide copy for the overlay (short). If you want, I can mock two variants once I have the numbers and the headline copy.

Maya Chen: thanks — target uplift for the marketing narrative is 15–20% P95 and ~25% cost reduction on average vs our previous baseline.
Blocker detail: if Alex's bench run shows <10% uplift we need to pull the claim or change the headline.
Bench run command (for eng):
```
# run content embed suite, stable routing
./bench/run.sh --suite=content-embed --profile=stable --output=bench-results/launch-2026.json
```
S3 path for draft results: `s3://redwood-launch/bench/launch-2026/`
Maya note: Sophie, I'll drop the final headline options in the doc by 11:30 PT.

Alex Rivera: ran a quick pass on the canary cluster — raw numbers from my run just now (local, single-try): P50=32ms, P95=118ms, median cost ~0.76 units/token. Baseline (previous model) for same suite: P95=150ms. So we're seeing ~21% P95 improvement in this run.
PR #482 — I left a tiny logging tweak, then I'll merge and trigger the scheduled canary. Expect canary traffic at 18:00 UTC. If nothing breaks we'll promote. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for `content-embed-v2` at 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z. Canary config: 5% traffic for 30 minutes; rollback threshold: error rate > 1.5% or P95 regress > 10%.

Jordan Park: Good — can we make the success metric explicit for marketing? Suggest success = (canary P95 <= 130ms) AND (error rate < 0.5%) during the first 30 min. If both met, proceed to promote. Also confirm rollback playbook: automatic rollback + paging eng-sre if error rate spikes.

Maya Chen: perfect — I'll update the post and the marketing checklist with those guardrails.
Action items: Alex to merge + monitor canary (18:00 UTC), Sophie to produce two hero variants after numbers, Kevin to prep tweet thread, Maya to finalize blog + images.

Maya Chen: thanks team — will post final PR link and the final screenshot once canary completes. :thumbsup:
